profile.headline: Systems Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a Full-Stack Developer and Tech Engineer passionate about working with people and creating web content to extend the frontiers of Web Design.

My professional experience ranges from Computer Science and IT to Project Management. The common denominator throughout my career has been to always deliver quality, and maintain high standards through effective communication and strong leadership. 

Bilingual: English – Spanish.

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Information Technology System Engineer
positions.description:
-Full-Stack Development: React, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, WordPress
-vSphere Virtualization and Docker Containerization
-Microsoft 365, Azure and on-premise services: Windows Server, Exchange Server and Linux Server administration
-Powershell, Office 365, PowerApps and Power BI
-Computer Network deployment and provisioning

positions.title: Sr Tech Support Engineer
positions.description:
-Support customers with service and troubleshooting requests
-Integration support hub for mail services, SSO, REST calls, and reporting
-Utilize support tools for logging and analysis: Splunk, Data Center, System Logs, Background Scripts
-Coordinate with team leads and managers in supporting ServiceNow customer instances

positions.title: Full-Stack Web Development Program
positions.description:
-Full-Stack Web application Development: React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, API
-Designed with a mobile-first approach and a11y principles. 
-HTML, CSS, Responsive Design, JavaScript
-Big O notation and Data Structures

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description:
-Sales forecast, budgeting and project management
-Maintained level of sales and budgeted labor under 60% prime cost 
-Hired and trained staff for the opening of new store
-Build business strategies and partnerships with customer and vendors

company.name: Left Bank Brasseries and LB Steak

positions.title: Programming Assistant
positions.description:
-WordPress and Joomla based web development
-Linux based server administration
-IT support and management
